items.title: Super El Niño No Guarantee Against Super Volatile Natural Gas Prices
items.summary: A mild 2026/27 winter in the Lower 48 due to a historically strong El Niño is looking increasingly likely, but extreme cold events and rising LNG exports could still stoke natural gas price volatility.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Test Boundaries of Key Technical Range
items.summary: Natural gas futures fluctuated this week in a span bordered by pivotal technical floors and ceilings as fundamentals painted a varied picture, with weather demand fading and LNG feedgas consumption ascending.

items.title: Norway Expands European Natural Gas Supply as LNG Prices Jump Ahead of Winter
items.summary: Norwegian natural gas exports to Europe are running ahead of last year’s pace heading into winter with the Nordic country’s largest oil and gas producer expanding its supply commitments with another five-year agreement covering nearly 1 Bcm annually.

items.title: US Natural Gas Exports to Mexico Provide Cushion for Bountiful Domestic Supply
items.summary: Soaring electricity consumption in Mexico is driving record demand for US pipeline gas, helping absorb robust Lower 48 production even as infrastructure vulnerabilities underscore Mexico’s deep reliance on imported energy.

items.title: Natural Gas Spot Prices Find Support Where Futures Falter
items.summary: Next-day physical pricing for natural gas strengthened in most regions on Wednesday, helped by robust LNG exports and an expected cooldown in the Upper Midwest and Northeast.

items.title: Rebounding Production, Mild Forecasts Send Natural Gas Futures Tumbling
items.summary: The midpoint of a whipsaw trading week saw natural gas futures move sharply lower amid signs of recovering supply and sluggish weather-driven demand in the forecast.

items.title: National Fuel Gas Split Opens Door to Appalachian Production Growth

items.title: Europe to Delay Methane Rules in Win for US LNG Suppliers
items.summary: The European Commission (EC) has formally adopted a proposal to postpone by one year certain parts of its far-reaching methane regulations after concerns mounted over how the continent’s top suppliers would comply with them.

items.title: Natural Gas Market Comeback Hits a Snag
items.summary: US natural gas futures retreated Wednesday despite strengthening cash prices and robust LNG feedgas demand, with recovering offshore production and forecasts for late-October warmth weighing on the outlook ahead of Thursday's storage report.
